# CRAFT Content

> CRAFT Content is a free web app and AI connector with eight content tools, by Shashwat Ghosh of Helix GTM Consulting, for demand generation heads and marketing teams. Give it a customer story, a topic or a draft, and it returns a case study, a newsletter or a webinar script. Add https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/mcp in Claude or ChatGPT, no sign-in.

- Web app (no sign-in): https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/
- MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in, read-only tools): https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/mcp
- Connect to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf: https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/connect/
- Docs (MCP and REST, every field): https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/docs/
- FAQ: https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/faq/
- Privacy policy: https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/privacy/
- Local npm package: @shashwatgtmalpha/craft-content-mcp
- Source code: https://github.com/shashwatgtm/craft-content-mcp
- Built by: Shashwat Ghosh, Helix GTM Consulting (https://www.gtmexpert.com)
- All connectors and Claude plugins: https://tools.gtmhelix.com/

## Tools

- [Case Study Generator](https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/tools/case-study-generator/) (`case_study_generator`): Build a customer case study from the challenge, solution and results you give (mode full), or an interview kit to collect them (mode discovery). Every result you list is kept, sector notes and questions are added when the sector can be read from your text, and a bracket marks anything you did not give.
- [Newsletter Builder](https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/tools/newsletter-builder/) (`newsletter_builder`): Build a newsletter draft: subject lines that use your full topic, hooks, key points, your own call to action as the button, and sector notes. Without key points it suggests five from the topic and sector. Statistics and stories are bracket prompts, never invented.
- [Webinar Script](https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/tools/webinar-script/) (`webinar_script`): Write a webinar run of show and script for your topic, audience, type and duration: speakers as you list them, polls with answer options, content blocks with sector points, anticipated questions and follow-up emails. Without key takeaways it suggests them from the topic and type.
- [Content Repurposer](https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/tools/content-repurposer/) (`content_repurposer`): Turn a source text into formats such as a LinkedIn post, an X thread, an email, a blog summary and quote cards (five by default). Key points are whole sentences chosen from your source by a stated rule and kept in its order; quote cards are never cut mid-sentence; the brand voice sets the closing line.
- [Thought Leadership Series](https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/tools/thought-leadership-series/) (`thought_leadership_series`): Write outlines of thought leadership articles (600 to 800 words each once expanded) from your topic, your take (quoted as you wrote it), the reader and your proof points. Each article follows its own angle and leads with a different proof point. Without proof points it suggests evidence to gather. Brackets mark what only you can supply.
- [Testimonial Capture](https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/tools/testimonial-capture/) (`testimonial_capture`): Prepare a testimonial request: the request email, interview questions for the customer's role and sector, quote drafts for the customer to edit, and a sign-off checklist. Uses your product name when you give it, and says so when you do not.
- [Sales Enablement Content](https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/tools/sales-enablement-content/) (`sales_enablement_content`): Build a sales kit: pitch order, a script for each objection (each answered with the sector's pattern and the proof point that fits it), competitor responses, discovery questions and follow-up templates. Without objections it suggests the ones your sector raises.
- [CRAFT Content Improver](https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/tools/craft-content-improver/) (`craft_content_improver`): Check pasted copy against listed rules (buzzwords, claims that need proof, fragments, unfilled merge fields, claims about the reader, a missing figure or ask), score each area with every deduction quoted from your text, and return the edits it made. If it finds no edit to make, it says so and prints no improved version.

## Questions and answers

### What is CRAFT Content?

CRAFT Content is a free web app and AI connector with eight content tools, by Shashwat Ghosh of Helix GTM Consulting, for demand generation heads and marketing teams. Give it a customer story, a topic or a draft, and it returns a case study, a newsletter or a webinar script. Add https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/mcp in Claude or ChatGPT, no sign-in.

### Is CRAFT Content free, and do I need an account?

It is free, and there is no account or sign-in. Use the tools in your browser here, or add them to Claude or ChatGPT as a connector.

### Does it use AI to write the answers?

No. Each tool applies fixed rules in the CRAFT Content code to the inputs you give it. It does not call an AI model and does not look anything up. When you use it from Claude or another assistant, that assistant writes around the tool's answer.

### What happens to what I type?

It is sent to this site's server, used once to build the answer, and dropped when the answer is sent back. Nothing is stored and nothing you type is logged. The privacy page has the details.

### How do I use CRAFT Content in Claude?

In Claude, open Customize, then Connectors, select + and then Add custom connector. Name it CRAFT Content, paste https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/mcp and leave the sign-in fields empty. The page Use it in Claude or ChatGPT covers Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf too.

### Who built it?

Shashwat Ghosh, Co-Founder and Fractional CMO of Helix GTM Consulting, founded in 2022 in Bengaluru. He has 24+ years in B2B and 10+ years of fractional experience, and created the EPIC, IMPACT and CRAFT frameworks and the Hub-Spoke Brand Messaging Methodology.

### Why does the newsletter builder give a different preview line each time?

The Newsletter Builder picks its preview line at random from a short list. Everything else it returns depends on your inputs and the current year.

### Why do some answers look like templates?

Several tools return a structured plan with [placeholders] where your inputs did not give a fact. When an answer shows a benchmark, target, rate, weight or other figure you did not supply, it is labelled "Example figure: replace with your own". Figures calculated from your inputs are not labelled. Suggested lengths, timings and counts are marked as suggestions. Replace every example and placeholder before you use the result.

### Can I call the tools from my own code?

Yes. Send POST https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/api/tools/<tool name> with a JSON body {"input": {...}}. The Docs page lists every field. Please keep to the rate limit of 30 requests per minute.

### Is the source code public?

Yes, at https://github.com/shashwatgtm/craft-content-mcp under the MIT licence. The npm package @shashwatgtmalpha/craft-content-mcp runs these tools locally; it can lag behind this site until a new version is published.

### Who is CRAFT Content not ideal for?

Teams that want finished, on-brand copy: each tool returns a structured draft to edit, with placeholders where your inputs gave no fact. Anyone who needs research or quotes gathered for them: the tools look nothing up; they work from the story and facts you give, and anything they add themselves is marked as an example, a suggestion or a placeholder. Teams that need saved drafts or approvals: nothing is stored, so keep each result where you keep your work.

### How do I report a problem?

Email shashwat@gtmhelix.com or open an issue at https://github.com/shashwatgtm/craft-content-mcp/issues.
